name: Meta
description: Meta is the company behind the Meta for Developers platform, whose Graph API and related products serve Facebook, Instagram and other Meta technologies.
notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. Candidate families were enumerated from the Meta for Developers documentation pages read on 2026-10-04 (sources developers-facebook-com-35c7caf5a9, developers-facebook-com-ad9938bb1e, developers-facebook-com-c121bb0b0b, developers-facebook-com-f820e9aa22, developers-facebook-com-3d88054c81); the list is what those pages name, not a complete inventory. The client token is documented by the provider as not secret and is therefore not a candidate family; it is a benign sibling to record when app-level families are researched. No fixed access-token grammar and no all-Meta family is assumed. One tool-corroborated claim (meta:app-secret body length) rests on scanner rule artifacts pinned in sources github-com-gitleaks-gitleaks-d47395c7b2, github-com-trufflesecurity-trufflehog-4ccefc32a4 and github-com-praetorian-inc-noseyparker-8d6f62ccdb, read 2026-10-04; it is consistency among artifacts, not a provider statement.
